---
id: tokay-gecko
title: Tokay gecko
---
The tokay gecko (*Gekko gecko*) is a nocturnal, vocal lizard of South
and Southeast Asian houses and forest. Setae on the toes hold to glass
by van der Waals forces. A bark-like call gives the English name.
Blue-gray skin with orange spots is typical of adults. They eat insects
and smaller lizards and are widely kept in terraria.
